annotations.title: IRS Section 179D & DoD CMMC 2.0 Readiness Gate

description: Check IRS Section 179D (Form 7205) energy-efficient commercial building scope and DoD CMMC 2.0 / NIST SP 800-171 SPRS readiness. Read-only diagnostic gate; zero tax deduction math.

building_sqft.description: Gross floor area of the commercial or tax-exempt building in square feet.

handles_cui_or_fci.description: Highest defense contract information sensitivity handled: 'none', 'fci' (Level 1), or 'cui' (Level 2+).

mandate.description: US federal statutory mandate to screen: 'irs_179d', 'cmmc_sprs', or 'both'.

prevailing_wage_met.description: Whether IRA prevailing wage and apprenticeship requirements under 26 U.S.C. 179D(b)(3) are satisfied.

query_note.description: Optional non-sensitive context note for diagnostic scope triage.

sprs_score.description: Current DoD Supplier Performance Risk System (SPRS) NIST SP 800-171 score (-203 to 110).

tax_exempt_allocation.description: Whether project claims a Section 179D(d)(3) designer allocation letter from a tax-exempt or government entity.

name: check_irs_179d_cmmc_readiness
